description: Changes the inbox: `inbox` (on/off, cap, reply-to, a welcome message each new user gets once) and `savedReplies` (the developer's canned answers in the panel; users never see them). Both wait for neblla_promote "save". The module: neblla_update_app features { inbox: true }. More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app_inbox

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

inbox.description: true / false, or { maxPerUser, replyTo, welcome: { text, name? } }; only the keys given change.

savedReplies.description: The whole list [{ id?, title, text }], up to 50; keep an id to keep that reply; null clears it.

name: neblla_update_app_inbox
title: Change inbox settings
